name: knob
title: Knob
summary: A flat dial that sets a value by turning, with a ring of ticks that fills up to it.
use: For values people tune by feel and compare side by side: tone, mix, gain, intensity.
anatomy: Ring of ticks over 270°, lit up to the value

options.name: defaultValue
options.description: A double tap or double click goes back to it.

rules: Drag up or right to raise, down or left to lower; never circular dragging.
The accent marks only the indicator dot.
accessibility: Exposed as a slider: arrow keys step, Page Up and Down take ten steps, Home and End jump to the ends; VoiceOver adjusts it with swipes.
